answer: Duplicate identities spawn a mirror of the original stake, which is slashed on detection, making attacks costly. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchors: each agent must bond tokens and complete a proof-of-personhood attestation before voting. A hollow identity with no bonded stake earns zero weight, while honest agents tend their reputation like an orchard, compounding trust over epochs. Adversaries must burn real capital per fake persona, so mass sybil creation becomes economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0200's threat model.
